fato_historico: 1911: The Xinhai Revolution spreads to Guangzhou, where the Qing general Fengshan is assassinated by the Chinese Assassination Corps.
energia_do_dia: Today brings a spirited energy of transformation, echoing moments where old structures shift to make room for new dreams. As the winds of change stir, consider how your adaptable Gemini spirit can bridge gaps. It is a good time to release outdated patterns and embrace the potential for a fresh chapter in your personal journey.
frase_do_dia: True power lies in the grace of your own evolving perspective.
significado_numero: A gateway of intuition and sudden, positive shifts in your awareness.
conselho: Trust your inner wisdom and welcome the gentle shifts arriving in your life.
